description: Read, grant and revoke purpose-scoped face or voice consent on OpenVibe.Vision: GET /api/v1/faces/consents and /consents/text, POST /consents/:feature with the signed current text, and DELETE /consents/:feature, which revokes and erases the template and derived data in one transaction. A person manages only their own record; the record says whose face or voice, the scope, expiry and how it was revoked (vision.consent@1).
